message.reasoning_content:
The description model already covers this artifact well; open claim c1 needs evidence. I can refine with a sharper analysis of the error magnitude. Let me compute the error scale: residual elements ~1e-5, fp32 rounding of u*alpha per element: relative error ~6e-8 of |u*alpha| ~1 → ~1e-7 absolute, which is ~1% of 1e-5 noise. Relative L2 error of the output ≈ ||δr||/||r|| ≈ sqrt(32)*1e-7 / (sqrt(32)*1e-5) ≈ 1e-2. Borderline — measurement needed. Also alpha in fp32 will not be exactly 1.125; error in alpha times u contributes systematic component, but that direction error is parallel-ish... Actually δ from alpha error is along u, which is orthogonal to residual direction, contributing directly.

I should record a refined description update to help the experimenter design a decisive probe, including exact-fp32-simulation on CPU possibility and the recentred reference (residual = noise component since reference can use exact alpha). No new description tasks open. Record update.
